column1: # Source-only productions of shared native date builder; Reference 0xb92640..0xb928f4; Classic 0xb8f680..0xb8f934.
# YEAR is the decimal native year. phase=tick-trunc(tick/100800)*100800; only tick==-1 bypasses phase and season selection.
# The native dates contain midspring/midsummer/midautumn/midwinter with no separator between mid and season.
# The out-of-year default intentionally lacks a season; doubled spaces in early/late productions are original native output.
